title: OffboardingExportRequestedPayload
description: t Conditional presence is stated here, not modelled with oneOf or anyOf. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

offboardingRef.description: The offboarding record to move from REQUESTED to COMPLETED or FAILED.

exportRef.description: Identifies this export; the result event carries it back.

scope.description: Whether the whole tenant or one entity is exported.

entityRef.description: The entity of an entity-scope export. Absent for scope TENANT.

retentionCustodyHolder.description: The retention custody holder, copied from the offboarding record; it holds contact data of the custody holder.

noticeWindowDays.description: Only lengthens the installation notice window; it never shortens it.
